title: At Startup Grind, Eric Ries: 'change the world for the better'
summary: Founder Priyanka Shinde's recap of Startup Grind reports a line Eric tells the room he left out of The Lean Startup.
blockquote: -> Eric Ries shared something he left out of The Lean Startup: "change the world for the better." A decade later, he's coming out with his new book - "Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad... and How Great Companies Stay Great." Can't wait!
